AcceptedInputOrigins.description:
The origins a coordinator accepts in a submit's `origin`. Decoding drops names this build
cannot decode instead of failing.

recent_requests.description: Samples from the last 20 native entries, not a lifetime duration total.

recorded.description: False means Pi has no ledger for this conversation, not measured zero.

DreamsAbstainReason.description: Model-selectable reasons. Exhausted attempts are absent: only the executor seals them.

DreamsRequest.description:
Everything a Dreams actor can ask the coordinator to do.
Invariant: no variant applies, executes a caller-chosen command, names a
target, or carries policy. Adding one is a security change, not a feature.

oneOf.description:
Seal (or reread) this run's window, coverage, base, before checks and evidence.
`summaries` is used only by the first, sealing call of a run.
One proposal attempt. Edits are full file contents; the patch is derived by git.
Seal an explicit abstention.

GitHubOwnerFilter.description: Partition notifications using repository.full_name, never subject/title text.

Goal.description: One persistent objective, executed by exactly one existing task.

last_rejection.description: The latest attempt to finish the goal that the runtime refused.

GoalActivation.description:
A set or resume starts an activation. Its continuations, budget and pinned
check belong to it, and a verification counts only in the current one.

check.description: Pinned by the first verification in this activation.

GoalCheck.description: A check the runtime runs itself against an artifact.

oneOf.description: `path` is absolute on the owning task's execution host once pinned.

entry_id.description: The retained `agent.goal_verification` entry in the task conversation.

oneOf.description: The activation used its continuation budget without a passing check.
The task's last turn was stopped.
`complete_goal` ran its check and it failed. The entry is retained.
Something tried to resolve the owning task without a passing check.

Written only in the commit that resolves the owning task after a passing
runtime check of the current activation.

GoalStatus.description: What `/goal` shows for the selected conversation.

conversation_id.description: Root for main, otherwise the task's conversation.

GoalView.description: A goal with the task that executes it, read together so progress is current.

oneOf.description: Assistant text whose source did not identify a semantic phase.
Coordinator-local Dreams review. Its request type has no apply variant.

image.description: Older hosts skip this field and answer with text.

offset.description: Text window in bytes. A host never applies it to an image.

parent.description:
Where to open the root terminal if the node allows it. A node on a
private Rex server checks its host and opens a new session instead.

oneOf.description: Distinct command so older hosts reject workspace routing before effects.
The first image chunk when the header names a supported image, else the text window.

source.description: Older coordinators report only Codex progress and omit this field.

ImportedConversationSummary.description: Coverage metadata for discovery and status reads, never an import record.

gap_count.description:
Total retained diagnostics. Older producers omit this and send all gaps,
so absence means the supplied array length is the full count.

gaps.description: Bounded diagnostic examples. Full diagnostics remain in the import record.

InputOrigin.description:
Trusted direct-input transport metadata, never inferred from text or host.
Omission is unknown, including legacy clients and non-human work.
`siri` is Siri or a Shortcuts action relayed by the iPhone app. `carplay` is the iPhone app's
CarPlay voice conversation, whose reply is read aloud to the driver. A client sends a value
only when the coordinator lists it in `AcceptedInputOrigins`.

InputWorkState.description: Durable processing state, separate from acknowledgement of a saved input.

JobExecution.description: A view of the existing Pi execution, never a second execution state machine.

JobRunReceipt.description: Durable admission of one requested run, independent of its execution result.

MessagePresentation.description: Source-independent display semantics; native originals are retained separately.

NoticeDetails.description: Publication-time evidence, independent of scheduled-job lineage. Never inferred from text.

NoticeOrigin.description: Immutable scheduled-run lineage copied onto the published notice.

complete.description: False when the file was longer than the check's single read window.

Recurrence.description: Canonical DTSTART/RRULE properties, with an explicit timezone and anchor.

duration_ms.description: Native monotonic request duration; absent in legacy/deferred entries.

coordinator_id.description: Missing from coordinators older than owner floors.

owner_epoch.description:
The epoch the failover authority granted this coordinator start.
Absent for a coordinator without a `[failover]` section.

accepted_input_origins.description: The origins this runtime validates, persists and names to the model.

conversation_settings.description: Missing on legacy runtimes; native clients gate typed settings per connection.

input_origins.description: Advertised by the runtime that persists and projects transport provenance.

oneOf.description: The native submission has been placed into the conversation transcript.

SavedConversation.description: Saved conversation identity and metadata; listing never starts execution.

SourceCheckpoint.description: Opaque to the caller and meaningful only to the matching provider/account.

oneOf.description: Omitted namespaces discovers every configured Google account.

owner_filter.description: Exact repository owner partition; omitted preserves unfiltered intake.

oneOf.description: An authenticated Slack API CLI prefix, optionally through a read-only wrapper.
Home Assistant REST `/api/states` intake using an explicit allowlist and credential helper.
Opt-in MyChart notifications/results through a configured read-only CLI.
Opt-in Ramp expense/reimbursement/approval activity through a configured CLI.

SourceCoverage.description:
Coverage concerns the adapter's documented polling window, not an archive of
everything visible to the account. Excerpts retain a source for deeper reads.

SourceScanProgress.description:
Safe progress for the frozen provider window, without calendar/chat IDs or
opaque cursors. Window bounds are Unix seconds; unknown counts stay unknown.

last_completed_at.description:
Last fully admitted scan, in Unix milliseconds. Older journals cannot
infer this from a successful page read and leave it unknown.

TaskGraphActor.description: Who a conversation belongs to in Beep Boop.

parent_conversation_id.description: The conversation of the task this agent works for. Its row is always present.

oneOf.description: No task or agent owns it, as with source triage.
No installed definition has this task's kind.
Parked after repeated restarts cut it off.
One model turn of a conversation.
A tool call. The name is absent once the call has settled.
Any other Pi task kind, verbatim, such as `agent.background`.

TaskGraphNode.description: One live Pi task. `id` and `owner` are Pi task IDs, never a Beep Boop `TaskId`.

background.description: Pi's lifecycle boundary: an abort of the owning conversation stops here.

blocked.description: Why this coordinator cannot run the task, when it cannot.

conversations.description:
Conversations this task owns in Pi. Delegate and agent conversations are not owned by a
Pi task; their parent is `TaskGraphActor::Agent::parent_conversation_id`.

owner.description: The Pi task that owns this one. None for a task its conversation owns.

TaskGraphSnapshot.description:
The coordinator's live Pi tasks at one moment, with the Beep Boop actor of each conversation.

Only live work appears. An idle delegate or agent has no node; `tasks list` and `tasks read`
answer what exists. Identity is read after the native frame, so a title can be newer than the
work beside it.

conversations.description: One row for each conversation a node runs in or owns, and for the task of each listed agent.

nodes.description: Live native tasks, an owner always before the tasks it owns.

omitted.description: Live native tasks left out because the snapshot is bounded.

oneOf.description: Parked until the tasks in `on` settle. A settled task has already left the graph.
Parked until the coordinator's clock reaches `until`, in epoch milliseconds.
The outcome is decided and held until the work this task owns has ended.

origin.description: Direct transport metadata retained in the durable task outbox.

TaskMessageSender.description: The native conversation that supplied cross-task coordination context.

name.description: Pi's provider/model key, or tool name for the tool ledger.

UsageCost.description:
Native SDK estimates are API-equivalent USD, never a provider invoice or
ChatGPT subscription spend. A zero/unknown native price is unavailable.

UsageTokens.description:
Pi's own-conversation ledger. Imported transcripts and fork ancestors are not
billed again; reasoning and one-hour cache writes are subsets, not extra tokens.

UtcMillis.description: An absolute instant that has the same exact representation in Rust and JS.

rex_instance_id.description:
`whoami.instance_id` of the Rex server that started this pane's process.
Rex restores a saved pane with a fresh shell under a new instance, so a
process in the pane is the worker terminal only under this instance.
Absent on a binding saved before this field, or made by an older host.
